worldcombat.skill.volttackle.summary: Charge up and tackle the target, discharging electricity into nearby enemies with a chance to paralyze; a hit causes recoil, while a miss grounds the charge harmlessly.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.description: The charged burst deals about %1$s contact damage; it charges up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block hit radius.

On a hit there is a %1$s%% chance to paralyze the target for %4$s. Paralysis halves movement speed and gives each attempted action a 25%% chance to fail; it can be cleansed. An already paralyzed target is not paralyzed again. You take %2$s of the actual damage as recoil and hurl the target %3$s blocks along the charge.

When the charge connects, electricity bursts from the impact. Up to %2$s other non-allies within %1$s blocks and line of sight take %3$s of the blow’s power, with a %4$s%% chance of paralysis lasting %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.discharge.o: Discharge form: larger arc radius and arc power, heavier recoil, a shorter charge and a longer cooldown, but less power on the main target - spread the charge over a crowd.
Focus form: more power on the main target, lighter recoil, a longer charge and a shorter cooldown, with a smaller arc radius and arc power - pour everything into one target.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costs %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.growth.0: From level %1$s the burst power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.growth.1: From level %1$s the burst power rises to %2$s and the paralyze chance to %3$s%%.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.use.0: Charge up and ram a blocker out of the way
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.use.1: Hit one foe in a crowd and arc into the others
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.use.2: Paralyze a carry and use the recoil shove to open space
On: larger arc radius and arc power, heavier recoil, a shorter charge and 6 ticks more cooldown, but less power on the main target - spread the charge over a crowd. Off (Focus): more power on the main target, lighter recoil, a longer charge, and a smaller arc radius and arc power - pour everything into one target.
It only starts charging within this distance; it closes in first. Higher means it charges earlier and is more likely to be interrupted or whiff.
Below this health fraction it stops charging up (unless the target is nearly down). The recoil is heavy, so higher values make it more careful.
On: the more enemies packed around a target the higher it ranks - the arc reaches the others; off: it only eyes one target.
worldcombat.skill.volttackle.description: The charge only hits the first living enemy in its path; if it misses or is stopped by terrain, the stored charge is grounded out on the spot with no recoil to the user.
